units.text: Aspose.PSD FOSS for Python reads and writes Adobe Photoshop .psd files, preserving layers, image resources, blend modes, masks, and image-data structures with RLE and ZIP compression. It inspects document metadata including width, height, channels, bits per channel, color mode, version, compression type, and ICC profile presence. The library supports saving modified documents using the PsdImage.save method and exposes layer collections, active layers, and image resources through the PsdImage API.
It inspects document metadata by exposing width, height, channels, bits_per_channel, color_mode, version, is_psb, layer_count, resource_count, compression, and has_icc_profile on PsdImage.
It provides access to the layer collection through PsdImage.layers and PsdImage.active_layer, and supports saving changes to layers while preserving raw bytes.
It handles blend modes using the BlendMode enum and LayerBlendModeMapper to map between 4-character PSD keys and enum values.
It exposes mask and blending ranges data through LayerMaskDataShort and LayerBlendingRangesData, providing read-only access to their raw properties.
It parses image resources using PsdImage.image_resources, supporting UnknownResource and preserved resource blocks to retain raw payloads.

It parses image data structures using ImageData, exposing the kind of structure, row length field size, row byte counts, compressed payload length, and whether prediction is used without pixel decoding.
It performs byte-exact round-trip saving by preserving all unmodified sections when PsdImage.save is called.
It supports non-seekable streams by loading from StreamContainer.Stream and BigEndianReader without requiring seeking capabilities.
This example loads a PSD file and prints each layer's index, name, and bounds to inspect the image structure.

The public entry point is the aspose_psd_foss package. It provides the PsdImage class to load, inspect, and save Photoshop files, and the ImageLoader class with load_from_path and load_from_stream methods to create PsdImage instances.
The PsdImage class represents a loaded Photoshop document and exposes its width, height, color_mode, layers, and image_resources properties, as well as the load and save methods to work with files.
The PsdImage.layer_count property returns the number of layers in the document, and the PsdImage.layers collection provides access to individual aspose_psd_foss.layers.layer instances.

BigEndianWriter class provides methods for writing binary data in big-endian order, including write_byte, write_bytes, write_all_bytes, write_int16, write_int32, write_uint16, and write_pascal_string_aligned_to_2.
LayerAndMaskSectionReader class provides a load method to read layer and mask section data, which raises PsdLoadException under certain conditions.
Point class represents a coordinate with methods empty, equals, and a read-only property is_empty.
PsdVersion enum lists the Psb and Psd version values.
Size class represents dimensions with methods empty, equals, and read-only properties IsEmpty and is_empty.
GlobalLayerMaskInfo class provides an empty method.

Layer class provides properties IsVisible, additional_layer_data, blend_mode_key, blending_ranges_info, bottom, bounds, channel_info, and channel_information, where channel_information, layer_blending_ranges_data, and layer_mask_data setters raise NotSupportedException.
LayerBlendingRangesInfo class provides read-only properties is_present and raw_data_length.
LayerBlendModeMapper class provides methods get_blend_mode_key and parse_blend_mode_key.
LayerMaskInfo class provides read-only properties is_present and raw_data_length.
LayerRawData class provides methods WithBlendModeKey, empty, and with_blend_mode_key.
LayerRecordReader class provides a load method and constants ADOBE_LAYER_SIGNATURE, ADOBE_LAYER_SIGNATURE_TEXT, and LAYER_INVISIBLE_FLAG, where load raises PsdLoadException under certain conditions.
LayerResource class provides read-only properties key, length, psd_version, and signature, and a save method, where psd_version getter always returns 0.
RawLayerBlendingRangesSection class provides methods empty and load, and a read-only property raw_data, where load raises PsdLoadException under certain conditions.
RawLayerMaskSection class provides methods empty and load, and a read-only property raw_data, where load raises PsdLoadException under certain conditions.
PsdImageLoader class provides a load method that raises PsdLoadException under certain conditions.
IndexedColorPalette class provides a read-only property entries, and methods parse and to_public_info.
PsdResourceKind enum lists the GLOBAL_ANGLE, ICC_PROFILE, ICC_UNTAGGED_PROFILE, and UNKNOWN resource kind values.
PsdImageDataInfo class provides read-only properties compressed_payload_length, kind, row_byte_counts, row_length_field_size, and uses_prediction.
